outcome: No result settling Dade's conjecture, a case of it, or a counterexample was found in the window; the only closely-tied development is Rossi's reduction theorem for the (distinct) Character Triple Conjecture, which does not itself advance Dade's conjecture's truth for any group.
summary: I confirm the triage's `none` verdict. Dade's conjecture (as stated on the frozen page: character counts of blocks of G vs. local subgroups) has no resolution, partial resolution, or counterexample in the window 26 Jan 2024–present. The one substantive, clearly-dated development that is closely tied to Dade's program is Damiano Rossi's 'A reduction theorem for the Character Triple Conjecture' (arXiv:2402.10632, posted 15 Feb 2024, published Proc. London Math. Soc. 2025). Its abstract states it proves the Character Triple Conjecture (CTC) — a self-reducing refinement of Dade's conjecture introduced by Späth — holds for all finite groups once it is assumed for quasi-simple groups, thereby completing a reduction program Dade himself pursued in the 1990s. I read the full text via arXiv's HTML rendering: Theorem A is exactly this reduction; the paper does not prove the CTC (or Dade's conjecture) for any quasi-simple group, let alone for Dade's conjecture itself, so no group's status under Dade's conjecture actually changes. Per the scope rule (§3.1), the CTC is a related-but-distinct statement (a different, more restrictive/self-reducing formulation with its own hypotheses) rather than a restriction of Dade's conjecture to a sub-case, and a reduction theorem for it does not remove any territory from Dade's conjecture as stated. I also checked: (1) the Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture proof for odd primes by Malle–Navarro–Schaeffer Fry–Tiep (arXiv:2209.04736, published Annals of Math. 2024) — this is a related but distinct local-global conjecture, and in any case its arXiv preprint predates the frozen revision (Sept 2022), so even if it counted as a case it would be `open_stale`, not new progress; (2) a claimed 2024 verification of the inductive form of Dade's conjecture for Ree groups 2G2(3^(2m+1)) at p=3 (cited to Linear Algebra and its Applications vol. 697, 2024) — I could not locate the underlying arXiv preprint or confirm its actual submission/posting date despite several targeted searches, so I cannot verify whether the underlying work occurred inside or outside the window, and did not find the paper itself to read past a search-engine summary, so I am not using it to change the status; (3) the 'Bolzano' LLM-assisted mathematics paper (arXiv:2604.16989) that surfaced in a search — its problem list (data-structure lower bounds, tiling, cryptographic optimization, algorithm analysis) has no connection to Dade's conjecture or block theory, confirming this was a spurious search hit rather than an AI-related event for this problem. No AI system appears anywhere in the material I could verify as bearing on Dade's conjecture.
competing_reading: If one takes an expansive view of scope in which the Character Triple Conjecture is considered 'the modern form of Dade's conjecture' rather than a related-but-distinct statement (some secondary summaries do describe Rossi's result as 'completing Dade's program'), Rossi's reduction theorem could be read as `progress` on Dade's conjecture with `ai_role` none and `resolution_direction` null. I did not adopt this reading because Dade's conjecture as literally stated (character counts vs. local subgroups) is not itself proven, disproven, or reduced to a smaller open case by Rossi's theorem — the CTC has different, more general hypotheses (character triples rather than blocks directly) and remains unverified for quasi-simple groups, so nothing about Dade's conjecture's own open status changed for any single group.
what_would_settle_it: A clear statement from a survey or from Dade/Späth-school authors on whether the Character Triple Conjecture, once verified for quasi-simple groups, would be considered a literal proof of Dade's original conjecture as stated on the frozen Wikipedia page, or only of a related reformulation; and confirmation of the actual posting date and content of the cited 2024 Ree-group inductive-Dade verification.
